secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for this app's hosted project — Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL (https://<project-ref>.supabase.co). A valid-format development placeholder is used until the real value is provided.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public API key — Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public. Public by design (ships in the client bundle); never use the service_role key. A development placeholder is used until the real value is provided.

secrets.name: VITE_WEATHER_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Only needed when VITE_WEATHER_API_PROVIDER=openweather; the default Open-Meteo provider is keyless.

secrets.name: VITE_MAP_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Map/tile provider key; the base map uses OpenStreetMap by default.

secrets.name: VITE_AIR_QUALITY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Air-quality provider key; Open-Meteo Air Quality is keyless by default.
